name: pgdiff
description: Diff two live PostgreSQL schemas and emit reversible up/down migrations.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pgdiff/core && npm run build -w @pgdiff/cli && npm run build -w @pgdiff/server && npm run build -w @pgdiff/web
scripts.dev: (trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT; npm run dev -w @pgdiff/server & npm run dev -w @pgdiff/web)
